method.engine: Real game update at1/60s; isolated Node VM with no-op DOM/canvas
method.startingState: Fresh Vanguard / Neon Expanse / no Hangar tools, meta equipment or purchased ships
method.driver: Movement toward XP/cache/repair pickups with local enemy/projectile avoidance; ordinary dash; desktop mouse aim, touch movement-facing
method.choices: Deterministic offered-item priority; normal specialisation, mutation and cache selection; no forced drops, gear or evolution
method.optional: Merchant and distress offers left optional/unaccepted by driver; normal systems continue running
limits: Five automated normal-rules runs, not human win rates
Instant menu choices; times are game-clock, not wall-clock
Changes alter RNG consumption and build choices; small-seed before/after is exploratory, not an isolated causal experiment
method.excludedDiagnostic: Initial keyboard-only fleeing driver failed to face enemies; excluded from balance conclusions and corrected to normal hybrid aim.
